request.prompt: Original hand-painted illustration for a Vietnamese friends trip journal in Ta Xua, Son La. Rich matte watercolor and gouache, fine colored pencil contours, visible paper tooth, warm ivory paint edges. Restrained jade and indigo mountain pigments, mist blue, sunrise peach and dusty rose, small warm yellow flower centers. Atmospheric, joyful and personal, coherent with a watercolor mountain travel scrapbook. No photographs, no glossy 3D, no vector flat clipart, no neon, no UI, no typography, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. A TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA sticker component sheet with SIX isolated subjects arranged in exactly 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows. Each subject stays completely within its own cell with at least 50 pixels empty transparent padding. Do not draw cell lines or labels. TOP LEFT: one small hand tied wildflower bouquet, dusty rose cosmos, peach blossoms and ivory daisies with yellow centers, sage green leaves, gathered stems tied with a loose soft jade ribbon. TOP MIDDLE: one delicate curved sprig of two dusty pink cosmos and sage leaves, for the bottom right edge of a portrait. TOP RIGHT: one delicate sprig of three pale golden peach daisies with sage leaves. BOTTOM LEFT: one delicate curved sprig of two raspberry pink flowers with sage leaves. BOTTOM MIDDLE: one single loose rose pink petal, simple soft watercolor shape. BOTTOM RIGHT: one single loose pale peach petal. All six are detached cutouts. Painted cream cutout outlines follow the flower contours closely. No background paper, no checkerboard drawn in image, no shadows outside the objects, no faces, no text. Clear complete silhouettes, no cropping.
